brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Cordura (matte woven) with TPU-welded waterproof roll-tops on Orca/Dolphin lines'. This is CORRECT for GT-54 (maker copy: 'Cordura 1000D', matte woven texture in every photo, full-zip not rolltop so the TPU-welded clause doesn't apply to it), CORRECT for the Handlebar Bag (sold as 'Cordura Black', matte woven texture, RF-welded seams per maker copy), and CORRECT for Orca (maker copy: '1000D TPU fabric with C0 Coating... 100% Waterproof welded construction' - this is exactly the TPU-welded roll-top the brand string calls out). It is WRONG for two products the string does not carve out: (1) Dolphin's own page gives 'Fabric: 420D Ripstop Nylon with PU coating' and 'Fully taped seams' - PU-coated ripstop nylon with taped (not welded) seams, not the TPU-welded construction the brand string explicitly claims for this exact product line; the studio photo shows a duller, more textile-like weave than Orca's glossier TPU face, consistent with the page. (2) Arkel TailRider 2's page gives 'EcoPak' recycled fabric - a laminate, not Cordura at all, and the brand string makes no exception for it. (3) The Rollpacker Rear's page gives 'Cordura 1000D AND X-Pac RX30 construction' - a mixed build, only half pure Cordura; the on-bike photo shows a slightly crisper, less matte face on the roll-top panel consistent with an X-Pac component alongside the Cordura panels.
brand_notes.method: arkel.ca is a Shopify store; curl with a desktop UA returns full server-rendered HTML (no JS wall), but none of the six product pages publish dimensions as page TEXT - every one puts them in a 'Technical details > Dimensions' infographic image (filename containing 'dimensions' or 'Dimensions'), found via `grep` on the raw HTML for cdn/shop/files URLs and read directly as images. Studio and on-bike photos were pulled the same way. WebFetch alone (HTML->markdown) misses these entirely since it cannot read images; every dimension below traces to an infographic or an on-bike photo actually opened, not to WebFetch's text summary.

products.name: Rollpacker Rear 20L
products.dims_raw: Arkel spec (20L): Closed width 38 cm (15"); Open width 46.5 cm (18.3"); Height of main compartment 9" (24 cm); Depth excluding front pocket 28 cm; Depth including front pocket 13.5" (43.3 cm); 20L (1220.5 cu. in.) plus a separate 2L front pocket.
products.dims_note: Per the NEW unfurled-len/wid rule, wid takes the OPEN (unfurled) figure 46.5 cm, not the 38 cm closed figure a previous pass recorded under the old rolled-down rule - see render.wid_cm below for what should actually be DRAWN (38 cm, the closed/as-ridden width), since drawing the mouth wide open would overhang the rack. len uses 'depth excluding front pocket' (28 cm) as the core body depth; the front pocket is a separate ~2L accessory pouch bulging forward by roughly another 15 cm (43.3 - 28), captured as a thin pockets[] entry rather than folded into len, the same treatment GT-54's fuel-bottle pocket gets below. hgt (24 cm) is Arkel's single 'height of main compartment' figure, not a range - no minimum to pick. FLAG FOR THE RESOLVER: if a build ever draws dims_cm directly instead of the render override, a bag that is 46.5 cm wide plus its own height will read as roughly the ~61-70 cm envelope that has been reported as overhanging the rack; the fix is to make sure geometry consumes render.wid_cm (38), not dims_cm.wid (46.5), for this product.

render.conflict: 46.5 cm is the honest unfurled/open mouth width per the new dims rule, but that is not the ridden state - Arkel's own 'closed width' figure is 38 cm, and the on-bike photo (Arkel_BikeBags_Rollpacker_OCEAN_BLUE_REAR) shows the roll folded down and FidLock-buckled shut, matching the narrower closed figure, not the open one.
render.basis: Arkel's own published 'closed width' spec, corroborated by the on-bike photo showing the roll folded and buckled.

geometry.notes: Structured box on a rigid aluminum hanger, not a soft tapered saddle wedge - the on-bike photo shows a fairly boxy two-tone (black underside, colour top) body with a flat roll-top mouth right behind the saddle and a separate front pocket bulging forward below it. Taper nose-to-tail is mild; no strong evidence of a pronounced wedge, so kept close to 1.

closure.hardware: FidLock magnetic buckle at the roll, matches maker copy ('one-handed access with a secure, snap-in magnetic closure')

details.seams: seam-taped (interior '200D Nylon laminated with PU coating and seam tape')
details.fabric: Cordura 1000D and X-Pac RX30 construction - see brand_notes.fabric; only partly matches the blanket 'Cordura' brand string

mount.notes: Proprietary rigid aluminum hanger (sold with the bag) clips to the saddle rails and braces against the seat post, so the bag rides level rather than sagging like a strap-hung seat pack - the on-bike photo shows it sitting nearly horizontal. tyre_mm is a visual estimate off that photo, not a measured figure.

products.name: Arkel Handlebar Bag (Large)
products.dims_raw: Arkel 'Handlebar Bag - Large' dimensions infographic: side elevation total height 9"/23cm (of which the roll-lid portion is 4.7"/12cm); side elevation depth 2"/5cm (side pocket) + 7"/18cm (main body) = 23cm; front elevation overall width 10.5"/27cm. Capacity per product page: 9.0L, weight 1230g.
products.dims_note: Arkel does not label which published axis is len vs wid, so the mapping follows the convention used elsewhere in this catalogue for boxy handlebar bags (across-the-bar axis = len, fore-aft depth = wid): len=27cm from the front-elevation width, wid=23cm from the side-elevation depth breakdown (5+18), hgt=23cm from the side-elevation total height. Note the Small size's infographic (same page) gives the identical 23cm depth breakdown, only height (17.35cm) and width (23cm) differ from Large - the depth figure may be a reused template value rather than independently measured per size; flagged, not corrected, since there is no other source. Box 27x23x23 = 14.3L against 9L rated (ratio 0.63), loose but plausible for a domed rolltop-style lid that doesn't fill its own box.

geometry.notes: Boxy body with a domed, rounded-top lid (not a rolltop - it's a fixed zippered flap). Two mesh side pockets bulge out low on the front face. Removable quick-release handlebar mount bracket visible on the rear face in every photo.

closure.hardware: single main-compartment zip pull, visible running across the front under the domed lid; exact wrap (straight vs full horseshoe) is not fully legible in the available 3/4-angle photo, so kept to the more conservative straight-run reading

details.seams: RF (radio-frequency) welded seams combined with traditional sewing per maker copy
details.fabric: Cordura, matte woven black - matches brands.json fabric string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Adjustable aluminum/stainless quick-release bracket clamps 22.2-31.8mm bars, tool-free removal. tyre_mm is a rough estimate (handlebar bags sit well clear of the front wheel), not measured.

products.name: Orca 2 45
products.dims_raw: Arkel 'Orca 2' dimensions chart, 22.5L single-bag column: roll-adjustable height '16-24 in / 40-60 cm'; width '12 in / 31 cm'. Page capacity text: 'Orca 45' pair name, single bag 22.5L (750/1070/1375 cu in for the 3 sizes), pair 45L. No depth/thickness figure is published for any size.
products.dims_note: PAIR/SINGLE NAME MISMATCH corrected: brands.json carried liters:45, but the page states 45L is the PAIR total and 22.5L is the per-bag rating ('Orca 25/35/45' are the pair-volume model names; the dims chart itself labels the same bags by their SINGLE volumes 12.5L/17.5L/22.5L) - capacity_l corrected to 22.5. hgt takes the MINIMUM of the published 40-60cm roll range per the new rule; box 31x(estimated 17)x40 = 21.1L against 22.5L rated (0.94), a plausible reconciliation, not proof, of the minimum reading. wid (depth/thickness) has NO maker-published figure on this page or in the dimensions chart - 17cm is a rough proportion read off the on-bike side photo (ARKEL_ORCA2_Red_22.5L_Sideview), not a maker number and NOT back-computed from volume (volume is cited only as corroboration after the fact). Treat wid as LOW confidence; the len (31cm) and hgt-range (40-60cm) are the maker-published, higher-confidence figures.

render.basis: 40cm is Arkel's own published minimum of the 40-60cm roll-height range; no on-bike photo showed a clearly shorter rolled state, so the rule's minimum is used directly with no override.

geometry.notes: Domed rolltop mouth at top, body narrowing slightly toward a rounded bottom corner - classic modern soft rolltop pannier silhouette, similar family to Ortlieb Back-Roller. Two side-release buckles at the roll ends in every product photo.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle at each end of the roll

details.reflective: reflective logo print plus light-tab mounts per maker copy
details.fabric: 1000D TPU fabric with C0 coating, PFAS-free - matches brands.json's TPU-welded clause; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Cam-Lock rigid hook attachment system on the back panel, '2 rear hook position for better rack compatibility'. Maker states the 45 (22.5L single) size is REAR RACK ONLY, unlike the smaller 25/35 which can go front or rear. clearance figures are visual estimates, not measured.

products.name: Arkel GT-54 Classic Touring Panniers
products.dims_raw: GT-54 dimensions infographic (front elevation): top width 13.25"/33.7cm tapering to bottom width 10.75"/27.3cm; upper section 5.5"/14cm + lower section 8.75"/22.2cm = total height 14.25"/36.2cm; top pocket flap 5.75"/14.6cm wide. Page text: Volume 54L (3300 cu in) for the PAIR, weight 3408g for the kit.
products.dims_note: Inherits the PAIR/SINGLE fix already on record: 54L is Arkel's stated PAIR total ('GT-54 Classic Touring Panniers (Pair)', one left + one right bag shipped), so capacity_l is corrected to 27 (per bag). Tapered axis per the spec rule: dims_cm.len takes the LARGER (top) figure 33.7cm; the taper to 27.3cm at the bottom is recorded in geometry.taper (ratio 0.81). No maker depth (wid) figure is printed on this infographic; 20cm is carried forward from the existing catalogue record, which reconciled it against volume (33.7x20x36.2=24.4L vs 27L rated, ratio 0.90) - flagged medium-confidence on wid alone since it is not directly read off a labelled figure in the infographic I could open, unlike len and hgt which are.

geometry.notes: Structured, not soft - internal removable aluminum frame plus a rigid UHMWPE back panel keep it square and let it fold flat for storage when the frame is out. Full-width top pocket flap, front bulge for the fuel-bottle pocket low on the face.

closure.hardware: dual heavy-duty YKK #8 zippers, 'Total Front Loading' full-perimeter opening

details.reflective: 3M reflective bands on the rear pocket and the sides
details.fabric: Cordura 1000D - matches brands.json fabric string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Cam-Lock patented attachment, asymmetrical left/right pair. clearance figures are estimates, not measured off a photo with a scale reference.

products.name: Dolphin 24L
products.dims_raw: 'Dolphin 48' (pair-name) dimensions infographic: front elevation overall height 19"/48cm, width 13"/33cm; side elevation main-pocket height 11"/28cm, overall height with roll-top 15"/38cm, depth 2.5"/6cm (front pocket) + 6"/15cm (main body). Page text: 'Total Volume (per bag): 24L', sold single or as a pair.
products.dims_note: Three height figures are published for one bag: 28cm is a sub-measurement of the main pocket ALONE, not the whole-bag height; 38cm is the side-elevation overall height with the roll-top drawn in its pictured (closed/rolled) position; 48cm is the front-elevation height with the mouth fully unfurled flat. Excluding the 28cm sub-part, the true unfurled/closed range is 38-48cm, and per the new rule the MINIMUM (38cm) is used. Width (33cm) is the front-elevation figure, taken as-is (not a range). Depth (wid) uses the 15cm main-body figure; the 6cm front-pocket bracket is a protrusion, not folded into the core body depth, the same treatment as GT-54's fuel-bottle pocket. Box 33x15x38 = 18.8L against 24L rated (ratio 0.78), a plausible loose fit for a bag with a domed rolltop and pockets not captured by a straight box.

render.basis: 38cm is the side-elevation figure with the roll-top shown closed/rolled in the infographic itself, distinct from the 48cm fully-unfurled front-elevation figure - used directly, no override needed.

geometry.notes: Two-tier silhouette: a domed rolltop upper body over a slightly recessed lower front pocket, visible clearly in the black studio photo. Reads as a stepped profile, not a single smooth wedge.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle at each end of the roll (Ortlieb-style roll-end hardware visible in the studio photo)

straps.note: 'route inside or outside on top of pockets' per maker copy

pockets.note: outside compartment; exact closure (flap vs zip) is not clearly legible in the available studio photo, described thin rather than guessed

details.reflective: light tabs for mounting safety lights
details.seams: fully taped, not welded (maker copy: 'Fully taped seams for 100% waterproofing')
details.fabric: 420D Ripstop Nylon with PU coating - does NOT match brands.json's TPU-welded claim for this line; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Cam-Lock attachment, serviceable aluminum hooks; oversized hooks available for 15-21mm rack tubing. clearance figures are estimates, not measured.

products.name: Arkel TailRider Trunk Bag
products.dims_raw: TailRider dimensions infographic: side elevation length 14.2"/36cm, height 6.3"/16cm; front elevation width 5.9"/15cm (23cm bracketed separately as 10.6"/27cm 'with full side pockets'). Page: capacity 11L, weight ~0.6kg, fabric 'EcoPak'.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no range published - the new unfurled/min-height rule does not need to choose between anything here. wid (15cm) is the core body width; the 27cm 'with full side pockets' figure is the fully deployed envelope and is not folded into the core wid, matching how other Arkel products' add-on pockets are kept separate from the base body dims. Box 36x15x16 = 8.6L against 11L rated (ratio 0.79), plausible for a rounded-top box with a domed lid.

geometry.notes: Rectangular trunk box with a rounded/domed top and a padded top carry handle running its full width. Front zip pocket low on the face, horizontal compression strap wrapping the body, reflective strips each side.

closure.hardware: top zip with an integrated rain cover stored in its own pocket

details.handle: padded grab handle across the top, part of the roll-cage-style top frame
details.fabric: EcoPak recycled laminate - does NOT match brands.json's Cordura brand string, which makes no exception for this product; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Quick-release velcro mounting system; maker requires 'a mounting rail or platform' with 'a flat top surface' - it does not clamp to a bare tube, hence rack_only. clearance is an estimate.
